exposure: Asherman syndrome treated by hysteroscopic adhesiolysis
cohort: A cohort of 428 women with hysteroscopically confirmed Asherman syndrome who underwent hysteroscopic adhesiolysis and did not have a history of cesarean section.
finding: Among women with Asherman syndrome treated by hysteroscopy and no history of cesarean section, 0.9% experienced spontaneous uterine rupture during pregnancy, leading to severe maternal and poor neonatal outcomes including death and lifelong disability.
